item.title: The Java Story
item.description:
Seeing a documentary like this being made available brings me a very special sense of satisfaction.

I have followed this story from the very beginning. In many ways, it is also part of my own journey: it was this movement, this evolution, and this transformation that helped shape my career.

Looking back and seeing everything that has already been achieved is a source of pride. But looking ahead is even more inspiring, because I believe there is still so much more to be done.
